blocks.text: Ab tak humne dekha ke vector function kya hota hai. Is page par hum khud vector function BANANA seekhenge. Kitab iske liye teen aasan steps deti hai. In steps ko ek recipe samjhiye: pehle ajza (ingredients) alag alag tayyar karo, phir unhein mila do, aur aakhir mein batao ke dish kab tak theek rehti hai.
Step-1: Determine the Components (components maloom karein): dekhiye ke har coordinate (\(x\), \(y\), \(z\)) time \(t\) ke saath kaise badalta hai. Har coordinate ke liye ek scalar function likhiye.

Step-2: Combine into Vector Form (vector form mein jorein): teenon components ko ek vector mein likhiye, chahe component notation \(\mathbf{r}(t) = \langle f(t), g(t), h(t)\rangle\) mein, chahe unit vectors ke saath \(\mathbf{r}(t) = f(t)\hat{i} + g(t)\hat{j} + h(t)\hat{k}\).
Step-3: Specify the Domain (domain batayein): \(t\) ki woh values bataiye jin ke liye function sahi hai, jaise time wali harkat ke liye \(t \ge 0\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yeh teen steps hi kyun? Vector function asal mein apne components ka majmooa (collection) hai. Is liye pehle har coordinate ko alag scalar function ki tarah samjho, phir sab ko ek vector mein likho, aur aakhir mein batao ke \(t\) ki kaun si values jaiz hain.
Dhyan dein: Step-3 mein kitab "range of \(t\)" likhti hai; is ka matlab hai \(t\) ki jaiz values, yani \(\mathbf{r}\) ka domain. Function ki range (output vectors ka set) alag cheez hai, jo 11.2.1 mein aayegi.
Ab kitab ki pehli misaal: cricket ya football mein gend ko angle par phenkein to woh ek kamaan (arch) jaisa raasta banati hai. Dekhte hain ke yeh raasta vector function se kaise likha jata hai.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.problem:
Projectile Motion
When a ball is thrown at an angle, its position over time follows a parabolic path under the influence of gravity. If the initial velocity is \(v_{0}\) at an angle \(\theta\), the position vector is:
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = (v_{0}\cos\theta)t\,\hat{i}\]
\[+ \Big((v_{0}\sin\theta)t - \tfrac{1}{2}gt^{2}\Big)\hat{j}\]
steps:
Diya gaya: ek gend (ball) time \(t = 0\) par origin se phenki gayi, initial speed \(v_{0}\) aur horizontal se angle \(\theta\) par; gravity \(g\) neeche ki taraf kaam kar rahi hai.
Maloom karna: position vector \(\mathbf{r}(t)\) kaise banta hai, yani components \((v_{0}\cos\theta)t\) aur \((v_{0}\sin\theta)t - \frac{1}{2}gt^{2}\) kahan se aaye.
Tareeqa: 11.1.3 ke teen steps: pehle har component alag se, phir unhein ek vector mein jorna, aur aakhir mein \(t\) ka domain batana. Sab se pehle hum dekhte hain ke gend ki harkat do hisson mein bati hui hai: ek seedhi aage (horizontal), ek upar neeche (vertical).

Step 1: Initial velocity ke do hisse
\[\text{horizontal hissa} = v_{0}\cos\theta\]
\[\text{vertical hissa} = v_{0}\sin\theta\]
Kyun: jis vector ki lambai \(v_{0}\) ho aur woh \(x\)-axis se angle \(\theta\) banaye, us ke components \(v_{0}\cos\theta\) aur \(v_{0}\sin\theta\) hote hain (Grade XI mein vector ko components mein torna, yani resolution).

Step 2: \(x\)-component (method ka Step-1)
\[x(t) = (v_{0}\cos\theta)t\]
Kyun: gend ko side mein koi cheez nahin dhakelti (hawa ki rukawat ko hum chhor dete hain), is liye horizontal speed \(v_{0}\cos\theta\) shuru se aakhir tak same rehti hai. Aur faasla = speed × time.

Step 3: \(y\)-component
\[y(t) = (v_{0}\sin\theta)t - \tfrac{1}{2}gt^{2}\]
Kyun: upar ki taraf gend \(v_{0}\sin\theta\) speed se chalti hai, magar gravity use \(g\) acceleration se neeche kheenchti hai aur dheema karti hai. Physics ki equation of motion \(s = ut + \frac{1}{2}at^{2}\) mein \(u = v_{0}\sin\theta\) aur \(a = -g\) rakhein to yahi milta hai.
Dhyan dein: minus sign gravity ki wajah se hai; isay plus likhna sab se aam ghalti hai.

Step 4: Vector form mein jorna (method ka Step-2)
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = x(t)\,\hat{i} + y(t)\,\hat{j}\]
\[= (v_{0}\cos\theta)t\,\hat{i}\]
\[+ \Big((v_{0}\sin\theta)t - \tfrac{1}{2}gt^{2}\Big)\hat{j}\]
Kyun: \(x\)-component hamesha \(\hat{i}\) ke saath aur \(y\)-component \(\hat{j}\) ke saath likha jata hai. Do scalar functions mil kar ek vector function ban gaye.

Step 5: Domain batana (method ka Step-3; yeh hissa hamari taraf se)
Gend \(t = 0\) se le kar us waqt tak hawa mein hai jab \(y(t)\) dobara zero ho jaye:
\[t\Big(v_{0}\sin\theta - \tfrac{1}{2}gt\Big) = 0\]
\[t = 0 \ \text{ya}\ t = \dfrac{2v_{0}\sin\theta}{g}\]
Is liye \(0 \le t \le \dfrac{2v_{0}\sin\theta}{g}\).
Kyun: time negative nahin ho sakta, aur zameen par girne ke baad yeh formula gend ko bayan nahin karta.

Tasdeeq:
\(t = 0\) par \(\mathbf{r}(0) = 0\hat{i} + 0\hat{j}\): gend origin se shuru hoti hai, bilkul jaise maana tha.
Raasta parabola hai ya nahin? \(x = (v_{0}\cos\theta)t\) se \(t = \dfrac{x}{v_{0}\cos\theta}\); ise \(y\) mein rakhein:
\[y = x\tan\theta - \dfrac{g x^{2}}{2v_{0}^{2}\cos^{2}\theta}\]
Yeh \(x\) ki quadratic hai jis mein \(x^{2}\) ka coefficient negative hai, yani neeche ki taraf khulne wala parabola. Kitab ki baat sahi saabit hui.
blocks.answer: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (v_{0}\cos\theta)t\,\hat{i} + \Big((v_{0}\sin\theta)t - \tfrac{1}{2}gt^{2}\Big)\hat{j}\), jo \(0 \le t \le \frac{2v_{0}\sin\theta}{g}\) (hawa mein rehne ka waqt) ke liye durust hai.

blocks.text: Kitab yeh bhi batati hai ke \((v_{0}\cos\theta)t\) \(x\)-component hai (horizontal harkat, mustaqil speed se) aur \((v_{0}\sin\theta)t - \frac{1}{2}gt^{2}\) \(y\)-component hai (vertical harkat, jise gravity dheema karti hai). Yeh model football, teer (arrow) ya rocket jaisi cheezon ke 2D raaston ko bayan karta hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
\(v_{0}\) ko "v naught" parhte hain, matlab initial (shuru wali) velocity. Kitab mein chhota sa 0 degree ke nishaan jaisa chhapa hai; ghabraiye nahin, yeh \(v_{0}\) hi hai.
Figure 11.3 ghor se dekhiye: dots baayen se daayen barabar faasle par hain, kyun ke horizontal speed mustaqil hai, har 0.5 s mein \(x\) utna hi barhta hai. Upar ki taraf dots chotti ke paas qareeb qareeb hain (gend dheemi ho jati hai) aur girte waqt phir door door ho jate hain.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Hamari taraf se misaal (kitab ka sawal nahin): \(v_{0} = 20\) m/s, \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\), \(g = 9.8\) m/s\(^{2}\) lein. \(\cos 30^{\circ} = \frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}\), \(\sin 30^{\circ} = \frac{1}{2}\), to
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = 10\sqrt{3}\,t\,\hat{i} + (10t - 4.9t^{2})\hat{j}\]
\[\mathbf{r}(1) = 10\sqrt{3}\,\hat{i} + 5.1\hat{j}\]
Yani 1 second baad gend taqriban 17.32 m aage aur 5.1 m upar hai.
Ab doosri misaal, jo 3D mein hai: ek drone jo talaash (search) ke liye ghoomta hua upar uthta hai.

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.problem:
Flight Path of a Drone
A drone taking off and moving in a helical search pattern can be modeled as:
\[\mathbf{r}(t) = 5\cos t\,\hat{i} + 5\sin t\,\hat{j}\]
\[+ 0.5t\,\hat{k}\]
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 5\cos t\,\hat{i} + 5\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.5t\,\hat{k}\); \(t\) seconds mein aur faasle metres mein.
Maloom karna: har component drone ki harkat ke baare mein kya batata hai, aur raasta helix kyun hai.
Tareeqa: is dafa 11.1.3 ke steps ulti taraf se parhte hain: function diya hua hai, hum us ke components ko pehchaante hain, dekhte hain ke woh mil kar kya karte hain, aur phir domain.

Step 1: \(x\) aur \(y\) components
\[x = 5\cos t,\quad y = 5\sin t\]
\[x^{2} + y^{2} = 25(\cos^{2}t + \sin^{2}t) = 25\]
Kyun: \(x^{2} + y^{2} = 5^{2}\) us circle ki equation hai jis ka radius 5 hai aur center \(z\)-axis par. Matlab upar se dekhein to drone 5 m radius ke circle par ghoom raha hai.

Step 2: \(z\)-component
\[z = 0.5t\]
Kyun: \(t\) jab bhi 1 second barhta hai, \(z\) 0.5 barhta hai; yani drone har second aadha metre upar jata hai, aik jaisi raftar se.

Step 3: Dono harkatein ek saath
Ek poora chakkar tab hota hai jab \(t\) \(2\pi \approx 6.28\) s barhe; is dauran drone
\[0.5 \times 2\pi = \pi \approx 3.14 \text{ m}\]
upar chala jata hai.
Kyun: gol ghoomna aur saath saath mustaqil upar uthna mil kar helix banate hain, jaise spring ya ghoomne wali seerhi. Har chakkar mein \(\pi\) m ki chadhai.

Step 4: Domain
\(t \ge 0\) (drone \(t = 0\) par urta hai); Figure 11.4 mein \(0 \le t \le 16\) dikhaya gaya hai, jahan unchai \(0.5 \times 16 = 8\) m ho jati hai.
Kyun: method ka Step-3: time ke saath harkat \(t = 0\) se shuru hoti hai.

Tasdeeq:
\(\mathbf{r}(0) = 5\hat{i}\): drone zameen par point \((5, 0, 0)\) se shuru hota hai.
\(\mathbf{r}(2\pi) = 5\hat{i} + \pi\hat{k}\): ek chakkar ke baad drone bilkul shuru wali jagah ke upar hai, \(\pi\) m unchai par. Helix wali baat pakki ho gayi.
blocks.answer: Drone \(z\)-axis ke gird 5 m radius ke circle par ghoomta hai aur saath 0.5 m/s ki mustaqil raftar se upar uthta hai: yani helix, \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 5\cos t\,\hat{i} + 5\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.5t\,\hat{k}\), \(t \ge 0\).

blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai: \(x\) aur \(y\) components 5 metre radius wali gol harkat dikhate hain, aur \(z\)-component 0.5 metre fi second ki mustaqil chadhai. Is tarah ke raaste asal zindagi mein nigrani (surveillance), talaash ke mission (search missions) aur hawai photography mein kaam aate hain.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Figure 11.4 mein drone har \(2\pi \approx 6.28\) s baad apni shuru wali simt ke upar wapas aata hai, is liye 16 s mein \(2\frac{1}{2}\) se thore zyada chakkar bante hain.
Ghor kijiye: Example 1 aur Example 2 dono mein wahi teen steps hain; farq sirf yeh hai ke har component mein kaun sa scalar function baitha hai.
Khud sochiye: agar drone ka function \(3\cos t\,\hat{i} + 3\sin t\,\hat{j} + 2t\,\hat{k}\) ho to radius aur chadhai ki raftar kya hogi? (Radius 3 m, chadhai 2 m/s.)

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Hamari taraf se misaal ka doosra hissa: wahi gend (\(v_{0} = 20\) m/s, \(\theta = 30^{\circ}\)) kitni der hawa mein rahegi aur kitni door giregi?
Domain wale formula se: \(t = \dfrac{2v_{0}\sin\theta}{g} = \dfrac{2 \times 20 \times \frac{1}{2}}{9.8} = \dfrac{100}{49} \approx 2.04\) s.
Is waqt \(x = 10\sqrt{3} \times 2.04 \approx 35.35\) m. Yani gend taqriban 2 second hawa mein reh kar 35 m door girti hai. Dekha aap ne, Step-3 (domain) sirf formality nahin; is se asal sawalon ke jawab bhi milte hain.

Ab zara dono misaalon ka muqabla kijiye. Projectile 2D mein hai, is liye us ke do components hain (\(\hat{i}\) aur \(\hat{j}\)); drone 3D mein hai, is liye teen components (\(\hat{i}\), \(\hat{j}\), \(\hat{k}\)). Projectile mein \(x\) seedhi raftar se aur \(y\) parabola ki tarah badalta hai; drone mein \(x\) aur \(y\) mil kar circle banate hain aur \(z\) seedhi raftar se barhta hai. Har dafa humne yahi kiya: pehle har coordinate ki kahani alag samjhi, phir sab ko ek vector mein jor diya. Exam mein jab bhi "construct a vector function" ka sawal aaye, yahi teen qadam yaad kijiye: components, vector form, domain.

Ek aur zaroori baat: \(\cos t\) aur \(\sin t\) mein \(t\) radians mein hai. Is liye drone ek chakkar \(2\pi\) seconds mein poora karta hai, 360 seconds mein nahin. Agar sawal mein raftar "radians per second" mein di ho, jaise \(\omega\) rad/s, to components \(R\cos(\omega t)\) aur \(R\sin(\omega t)\) bante hain; is unit ki exercises mein aisa sawal aayega.

Projectile ka ek mazedaar nateeja bhi dekh lijiye. Gend sab se upar tab hoti hai jab us ki upar ki raftar zero ho jaye, yani aadhe safar par: \(t = \dfrac{v_{0}\sin\theta}{g}\). Is waqt unchai \(y = \dfrac{v_{0}^{2}\sin^{2}\theta}{2g}\) hoti hai, aur poora faasla (range) \(\dfrac{v_{0}^{2}\sin 2\theta}{g}\). Yeh formulas aap physics mein bhi parhte hain; yahan woh seedha vector function ke components se nikal aate hain. Isi liye kehte hain ke vector function harkat ki poori kahani apne andar rakhta hai: kahan, kab, kis taraf.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text: Khud sochiye: agar gend seedhi upar phenki jaye (\(\theta = 90^{\circ}\)) to \(\cos\theta = 0\), aur \(x\)-component hamesha zero rahega. Matlab gend sirf upar neeche hogi, aage nahin jayegi. Aur agar \(\theta = 0^{\circ}\) ho (zameen ke barabar)? Tab \(\sin\theta = 0\), aur \(y = -\frac{1}{2}gt^{2}\): gend foran neeche girna shuru kar degi. Formula har soorat mein aqal ke mutabiq jawab deta hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Step-1: har component maloom karo (\(x\), \(y\), \(z\) time ke saath kaise badalte hain). Step-2: sab ko ek vector mein likho. Step-3: \(t\) ka domain batao.
2. Projectile: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = (v_{0}\cos\theta)t\,\hat{i} + ((v_{0}\sin\theta)t - \frac{1}{2}gt^{2})\hat{j}\): horizontal speed mustaqil, vertical harkat gravity se dheemi.
3. Drone: \(\mathbf{r}(t) = 5\cos t\,\hat{i} + 5\sin t\,\hat{j} + 0.5t\,\hat{k}\): 5 m radius ka circle + 0.5 m/s chadhai = helix.
4. Harkat wale sawalon mein domain aam tor par \(t \ge 0\) se shuru hota hai.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(y\)-component mein \(+\frac{1}{2}gt^{2}\) likh dena: gravity neeche kheenchti hai, is liye sign minus hai.
2. \(\cos\theta\) aur \(\sin\theta\) ki jagah badal dena: \(\cos\theta\) horizontal hisse ke saath, \(\sin\theta\) vertical ke saath (jab \(\theta\) horizontal se naapa gaya ho).
3. Domain likhna bhool jana: Step-3 bhi jawab ka hissa hai.
4. Drone ka radius 0.5 samajh lena: radius \(\cos t\) aur \(\sin t\) ke saamne wala 5 hai; 0.5 chadhai ki raftar hai.
